description: This file contains functional tests for the AccountController's SignIn actions and related profile update functionalities in an ASP.NET Core web application. It uses xUnit for testing and tests various sign-in and profile update scenarios.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: Test class for verifying the sign-in page behavior, token handling, and profile updates for the account controller.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the sign-in page returns a success response and contains a specific email address in the response body.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Validates that the regex correctly matches the request verification token input field in the HTML response.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Checks that the sign-in page contains a valid request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Verifies that posting valid credentials results in a redirect, indicating a successful sign-in.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Performs a login, navigates to the profile page, updates the phone number, and checks that the change is reflected.
